label: Egocentric video
definition: First-person video of the subject's visual field

label: Body position
definition: Position of the subject's body in the scene

label: 3D marker positions
definition: Positions of reflective or active body markers

label: Fine motor kinematics
definition: Sub-millimetre, millisecond-scale movement of hands or forelimbs

label: Body movement
definition: Movement of the body without a specified sensing modality

label: Body acceleration
definition: Linear acceleration of a body segment

label: Angular velocity
definition: Rotational velocity of a body segment

label: Segment orientation
definition: Orientation of a body segment in space

label: Ground reaction force
definition: Force exerted by the ground on the body

label: Respiratory effort
definition: Chest or abdominal movement from breathing

label: Energy expenditure
definition: Metabolic energy expenditure from gas exchange

label: MEG magnetic field
definition: Magnetic field generated by neural currents

label: fNIRS haemodynamics
definition: Cortical oxy- and deoxy-haemoglobin from near-infrared spectroscopy

label: Optical neural activity
definition: Neural activity read out by optical indicators

label: Ultrasonic audio
definition: Sound above the human hearing range including ultrasonic vocalizations

label: Sound source location
definition: Direction of arrival or position of a sound source

label: Range
definition: Distance between the subject and a reference point

label: Individual identity
definition: Which individual is present at a reader

label: Operant response
definition: Responses on a cognitive or operant task

label: Water flow
definition: Flow of water in the environment around the subject

label: Self-report
definition: Answers to surveys or ecological momentary assessment

label: Smartphone usage
definition: App and keyboard usage logged on a phone
